description: The individual draft that draft-ietf-moq-msf-00 cites as [LOC]. Its 2.3 frames an even type's value as Length and bytes, which its [MoQTransport], draft-ietf-moq-transport-10 (9.1.1.2), frames as one varint. All four of its types are even, so none of its values can be read as it declares them.
